name: Blue Tower, Third Floor
desc1: This circular room's walls are engraved with glittering patterns, and
desc2: illuminate the room with a soft glow. Rows of shelves, tables, and
desc3: glass display cases are filled with arcane items. A silvery staircase
desc4: leads up and down here, and a sign posted on the wall reads "This
desc5: floor: Arcane Weaponry. For Sale: Blunt Arcane Weaponry."
